public_trace_findings: The same previous-song task succeeded, this time after a direct printed no-answer completion call and only 65.6 seconds.
The reserve did not convert the other five episodes: long model requests and continued docs/auth/schema errors still prevented valid completion claims.
The artist-extremum trace used an irrelevant authenticated/following/library workflow and invalid credentials rather than the public artist/search endpoints.
The album task retrieved the correct album list but assumed an albums wrapper and nonexistent endpoints instead of using the returned list/song_ids.
decision: The reserve is promising for latency but insufficient under bootstrap-induced model stalls. Compare no-bootstrap I and authenticated-onboarding K before selecting S2.
